variant_definitions.current_only: Change only the present HIER gradient, preserving native old m/v; not a new training trajectory.
variant_definitions.all_gradient_history: Scale current g and old m by s=lambda_new/.5, old v by s^2. Exact rescaling identity at the same assumed gradient history; not a rerun because parameters and gradient evaluation points are held fixed.
variant_definitions.lr_half_only: Actual fixed-state one-step LR .005 versus .01 initially; WD scales with LR as AdamW specifies.
variant_definitions.eps1e4_only: Actual fixed-state one-step eps change; old history preserved.
